module_title: The Superlatives: Highest, Longest, and Oldest
introduction: At this level, we cover the 'Superlatives' which are the absolute favorite questions of SSC and Railway exams. The name, river, and state of these dams must be memorized thoroughly.

core_concepts.title: Highest Dam
core_concepts.description:
**Tehri Dam:** It is the highest dam in India (260.5 meters). 
River: Confluence of **Bhagirathi** and Bhilangna rivers. 
State: **Uttarakhand**.

core_concepts.title: Longest Dam
core_concepts.description:
**Hirakud Dam:** It is the longest dam in India (and one of the longest earthen dams in the world). 
River: **Mahanadi**. 
State: **Odisha**.

core_concepts.title: Oldest Dam
core_concepts.description:
**Kallanai Dam (Grand Anicut):** It is the oldest functional dam in India, built in the 2nd century AD by the Chola king 'Karikala'. 
River: **Kaveri**. 
State: **Tamil Nadu**.

core_concepts.title: Largest Gravity Dam
core_concepts.description:
**Bhakra-Nangal Dam:** It is the largest multipurpose river valley project in India. 
River: **Sutlej**. 
State: Bhakra is in Himachal Pradesh and Nangal is slightly downstream in Punjab. 
Key Fact: The massive artificial lake behind it is called **'Govind Sagar Lake'**.

important_entities.name: Temples of Modern India
important_entities.significance: A very common exam question: 'Who called multipurpose river valley projects the Temples of Modern India?' Answer: India's first Prime Minister, Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.alert_title: Bhakra and Nangal are TWO Different Dams!
trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: People often assume it is a single dam. However, 'Bhakra' is the main dam located in Himachal Pradesh (Bilaspur), while 'Nangal' is situated a few kilometers downstream in Punjab. Both are on the Sutlej River.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: The Hirakud (Hira) dam is on the Mahanadi (Maha/Great river). A Diamond (Hira) is extremely hard and lasts a 'Long' time (Longest Dam).

exam_strategy_tips: The easiest and most guaranteed SSC CHSL/MTS question: 'Hirakud, the longest dam in India, is built on which river?' Answer: Mahanadi (Odisha).
